description:
Mark Nestor Property Services is delighted to present this beautiful and distinctive period property located just outside Roscommon Town, offering a wonderful combination of character, charm and comfortable living.

Full of period features, the property has a unique atmosphere and plenty of character throughout. A particular highlight is the beautiful old church-style windows, which add to the property’s historic charm and create a bright and welcoming feel.

The accommodation comprises three bedrooms, with one bedroom located downstairs and two bedrooms upstairs. The home also features a lovely open-plan kitchen and dining area, ideal for everyday living and entertaining, along with a comfortable sitting room positioned at the centre of the home, creating a warm and inviting heart to the property.

Set in a peaceful location just outside Roscommon Town, the property offers the best of both worlds — a quiet countryside setting while remaining within easy reach of the town and its amenities.

A rare opportunity to rent a character-filled period home with distinctive architectural features and a warm, homely feel.
